# kyverno-secrets-drill.yml runs the drill's assertions with pytest.
# pytest-xdist because the repository's pyproject.toml sets addopts = "-n auto" (crew#584,
# 93f49ec7, 2026-08-28): pytest reads that ini option in every environment, so an environment
# that installs pytest without the plugin dies at argument parsing -- `error: unrecognized
# arguments: -n` -- before a single test is collected. This drill went red on every run from
# 2026-08-28 19:34Z for exactly that reason and nothing about the Kyverno policy was graded.
pytest
pytest-xdist
pyyaml
